prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a low-speed head-on collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1194; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Inspection of the front end shows a cracked bumper cover, a bent upper radiator support, and a damaged hood latch, all consistent with the reported low-speed frontal impact. The pattern and location of the crush line match the described collision, and no older damage was found or reported on this vehicle. The repair plan replaces the bumper cover, hood latch, and radiator support, with a standard alignment check. The labor hours listed fit the work required, and the parts and invoices submitted contain no repeated charges. Recommend approval of the estimate as written.
